queries_run: Coinbase Global product substitute technology threat 2026 decentralized exchange Hyperliquid competition

findings.claim: Coinbase 10-K FY2025 risk factors say new services/technologies (decentralized networks, generative AI) may be superior to or render obsolete its current products and may fundamentally alter use of its services in unpredictable ways.
findings.excerpt: We expect new services and technologies to continue to emerge and evolve, which may be superior to, or render obsolete, the products and services that we currently provide. For example, decentralized networks and other disruptive technologies such as generative AI may fundamentally alter the use of our products or services in unpredictable ways.

findings.claim: Artemis data cited in early Feb 2026: on-chain perp exchange Hyperliquid processed ~$2.6T notional volume in 2025 vs ~$1.4T for Coinbase.
findings.source: Whale Alert, Hyperliquid processes $2.6T in 2025 notional volume—surpasses Coinbase
findings.excerpt: According to Artemis data released in early February 2026, Hyperliquid processed approximately $2.6 trillion in notional trading volume during 2025. Over the same period, Coinbase recorded about $1.4 trillion.
